title: Change Order
summary: Document a change to the scope, price or schedule of an existing contract.
useWhen: A project needs more or different work after the original contract was signed, for example in construction, remodeling, software or creative work.
watchOuts: Sign the change order before the extra work starts. Many contracts and some state home-improvement laws require written change orders, and unsigned extras can be hard to collect.
For home improvement work, some states require specific content in contracts and change orders, and may require the contractor to hold a license. Verify locally.
State the new contract total so everyone knows the running price.

variables.label: Original contract
variables.help: Name and date of the original contract, e.g. 'Kitchen remodel contract dated March 1, 2026'.

variables.label: Description of the change
variables.help: Exactly what is added, removed or changed. Include materials, specifications and allowances.

variables.label: Reason for change
variables.help: E.g. owner request, unforeseen conditions, code requirement.

variables.label: Price change amount
variables.help: Amount of the increase or decrease.

variables.label: Contract total before this change
variables.help: Original price plus earlier approved changes.

variables.label: Schedule change (days)
variables.help: Days added to (or removed from) the completion date. Enter 0 for no change.

variables.label: Payment for this change
variables.default: Paid with the next progress payment

sections.title: 3. Price
Schedule
sections.body: Change to the schedule: {{schedule_change_days}} days. New completion date (if changed): {{new_completion}}.

sections.title: 4. Effect
sections.body: This change order is part of the original contract. Except as changed here, all terms of the original contract stay in effect. Contractor will not start the changed work until both parties have signed. This change order includes all costs and time for the described change, unless it states otherwise.

sections.title: Signatures
sections.body:
By signing below, each party agrees to this document.

**Client / owner** — {{client_name}}

Printed name: [[name:client]]
Date: [[date:client]]

**Contractor** — {{contractor_name}}

[[sig:contractor]]

Printed name: [[name:contractor]]
Title (if signing for a company): [[text:contractor:Title]]
Date: [[date:contractor]]

disclaimer: This is a starting template from the Chucksi open contract library. It is not legal advice, and using it does not create an attorney-client relationship. Laws vary by state and change over time. Have a licensed attorney in your state review it before you sign.
